verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Auto Drafts explicitly 'insert availability' pulled from your calendar (docs-38), the Calendar feature lets you 'Find Time' to instantly see when teammates are free (docs-7), and users can add plain-language instructions like 'use this booking link' to personalize scheduling in drafts (docs-9, docs-54, docs-60). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of this exact workflow and more detail on native booking-link generation vs. relying on a user-supplied link.
